ios.desc:
Box a frog. Rewire your brain.


Tired of brain training apps that just make you better at... the app? Brain Frog is different. It's the world's first brain trainer hidden inside a hilarious frog boxing game on a lily pad ring.
How it works:
Punch randomly. No patterns. No habits. The Brain Frog reads your moves like a pro fighter - if you get predictable, BOOM - you're OUT. 

Force yourself to stay truly unpredictable, and you'll win.


This isn't fake "brain games." It's real cognitive training:
1) Break automatic behaviors (your brain's worst enemy)
2) Build flexibility under pressure (like elite boxers & poker pros)
3) Rewire neural pathways (science-backed neuroplasticity)

Download now - your brain will thank you (after a few KOs).
